title: Mini Drawing App
description: A simple drawing and pixel art app where you can draw, save, and customize your creations with a fun interface.
how_to_play:
1. Select a brush or pixel tool.
2. Click or drag on the canvas to draw.
3. Use color picker to change colors.
4. Use 'Undo' to revert mistakes.
5. Save your artwork to your computer.

Tips:
- Keep your canvas organized.
- Experiment with colors and pixel patterns.
- Use small brush sizes for pixel art precision.
